contexts.text: Filled with violence () = their filthy cupidities. AC 623.
Violence is predicated of the things of the will, when vastated. AC 623:2.
It is called violence, when men inflict violence on holy things, by profaning them. Illustrated.
The violent. Treated of.
The earth is filled with violence () = that they no longer had the will of good.
That violence inflicted on charity will punish itself. Signified, Explained.
Blood = violence inflicted on charity. Illustrated.
That thus the Celestial could not be violated. Signified, Explained.
That thus the truth which was to be conjoined with the Celestial might have been violated. Signified, Explained.
Truths of conscience are various... and the Lord wills not to do violence to them. Explained.
Lest they should do violence to the good of charity. Signified, Explained.
Lest they should do violence to the good of charity and the Lord's Divine Human and proceeding Divine. Signified, Explained. AC 2365.
The violent ones of the nations () = evils that destroy goods. AE 388:12. AE 537:16.
Evils, falsities, and unmercifulness continually strive to do violence to these holy things...

Instruments of violence are their swords () = falsities and evils which inflicted violence on truths and goods. ( = that the doctrinal things serve to destroy the works of charity, thus charity itself. AC 6353.)
That violence = the destruction of charity.
That violence = force put upon charity. Illustrated.
That it was full of violence and hostility towards truth and good. Signified, Explained.
Violence done to Divine truth. Signified.
Violence inflicted on charity, also on faith, and thus on the holy truth which proceeds from the Lord. Signified. Violence is inflicted on it when it is falsified.
There is such an order in Heaven from the Lord, that nothing is done violently; but all things in freedom.
The endeavour to inflict violence by an influx of falsity from evil. Signified, Explained.
The endeavour, with the evil, to inflict violence. Signified, Explained.
That they are not far from inflicting violence on truth from the Divine. Signified, Explained.
Because they want to inflict violence on the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
To sanctify it = no violation in any way. Explained.
The Sabbath not to be violated in any way. AC 8895.
That he is not guilty of the violence which has been inflicted. Signified, Explained.
To inflict violence on truth Divine, that is, on the truth of good, and also on good itself. Signified. For he who inflicts violence on truth, inflicts violence on good also. Explained.
He is guilty of the violence inflicted on (good and truth). Signified, Explained.
To be a witness of violence () = no affirmation of such things as are contrary to the good of charity.
Violence = the destruction of the good of charity.
Violent men () = (evils and falsities) which inflict violence on goods and truths.
A perpetual endeavour to dissolve and do violence to marriages.
The laws of religion (to be) in no way violated in the deeds.
The Word, to which violence had been done. Signified.
If a man is in the knowledge of correspondences, he can do violence to the spiritual sense.

He who confirms evil loves inflicts violence on Divine goods; and he who confirms false principles inflicts violence on Divine truths: the latter violence is called the falsification of truth, and the former the adulteration of good. Both are meant by bloods.
Lest the holy goods and truths which lie hidden interiorly in the Word, be violated and profaned. Signified, Explained.
Violence inflicted on the Word by direful falsifications of truth. Signified, Explained.
The bishop cried, Violence! violence! TCR 389:end.
Divine truth in the ultimate sense... to which violence has been done. Signified, Explained.
On the lust of violation. General article. SE 6110:4.
These violators. Described. CL 512.
This is not from any lust of violation.
On the correspondence of whoredoms with the violation of spiritual marriage. Explained.
God never violates man's free will...
On the torment of those who use violence against others. Explained.
That he who lives in faith in the Lord... cannot possibly suffer violence from the evil. Explained.
That ability to resist the evil, even with violence, is granted. Explained.
On the penalty of those who want to do violence to infants.
He had forcibly violated many.
Where there are filthinesses from adulteries and violations.
On the sphere of violation.
This is meant, in the internal sense, by the violation of virgins, and by the violent, in the Word.
On a cadaverous breast from the violation of marriage. Explained.
Some men, who love violations... want the wives to fight their husbands...
Full of violence () = puts force on the good of charity.
To draw to them the habitation of violence () = to live a life contrary to charity.
To redeem out of the hand of the violent () = to deliver from the falsities which offer violence to the good of charity. The violent = these falsities, and therefore those who are in them.
He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence () = deliverance from the evils and falsities which destroy the goods of love and truths of faith.
Violence shall no more be heard in thy land ... () = there shall no longer be disagreement between the spiritual and natural man. Violence = disagreement.
The blast of the violent ones () = things contrary to the goods and truths of the Church. Those are called the violent who endeavour to destroy goods and truths...
The violence of Lebanon () = force put upon the truths perceived by the rational man from the Word.
The violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell in it () = force put, by means of falsities, upon the truths and goods of the Church, and upon its doctrine...
Violence to the sons of Judah... () = violence to the truths and goods of the Word. ( = the adulteration of the Word as to good. AE 730:20.)
To those who have perceived delight in violating women, there is nothing more delightful than a cadaverous stink.
He is called a man of violences () who, with a wicked purpose, inflicts violence on the truths of the Word by perverting them. AE 750:20. AE 866:4.
The Word in the letter on which violence has been inflicted by adulterations and falsifications of it. Signified.
The desire of violating... then perishes.
There are cadaverous Hells for those to whom violations of wives had been delightful.
